component.name: Sleeve
component.summary: Find out where to buy an album

description.p: Sleeve answers one question: given an album, where should the money go? It is not a "where can I stream this" tool. It ranks the ways of getting a record best-first, and shows the arithmetic behind every placement.
Four principles decide the order, and the first two are guaranteed by the sort rather than by the weights:

ul.li: Owning DRM-free files beats renting. A purchase outranks any stream, always.
Master quality beats format specs. Bit depth and sample rate are tiebreakers only.

description.p: Search is a first-class part of it, because album and artist names collide constantly. Sleeve returns a ranked list of candidates rather than guessing, keeps similarly-named records in their own section, and lets you drill from an album to the specific pressing — the original, the remaster, the deluxe edition — because those are different products with different masters.

It consults MusicBrainz, Discogs, Bandcamp, Qobuz, the iTunes Store, Odesli and the Dynamic Range Database. A source that fails leaves a visible "not checked" row rather than quietly shrinking the answer.
